data.one_liner: A minimalistic JPEG encoder for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It encodes raw RGBA image data into JPEG format. It is designed to be lightweight and purely focused on JPEG conversion without offering full image manipulation capabilities.
use_when: You need to convert a dart:ui Image into a JPEG byte array.
You want a minimal encoder without heavy image processing dependencies.
avoid_when: You need advanced image editing, cropping, or filtering.
You require the highest level of image compression and optimization.
strengths: Direct Dart port for simple JPEG creation.
weaknesses: Does not offer extra image manipulation functionality.
Not necessarily the most optimized or best compressed JPEG output.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need full image manipulation, decoding, and encoding support for multiple formats.
